label: Sparse original-phase feature after runs of v/e/j/o/u (unresolved conjunction)
explanation: Very sparse (0.02% of steps). 95% of mass is in the original phase at t=3-8 (peak t=3-4). It almost never fires at t<2, and fires rarely on the delimiter or in the copy phase. It is enriched when the previous input is o/e/u/j (8-9x lift for o/e), when the input two steps back is v/e/j, when the sequence starts with v (10x), and when the current input is 1/w/u/3/m/q. The top examples look like v at position 1 followed by e/j/o (e.g. m v j o [u], y v e o [q]). These enrichments do not combine into a precise rule: every conjunction tried stays below ~11% precision, and the best F1 is about 0.14. The feature seems to pick out a narrow hidden-state region reached through many prefixes containing v/e/j/o/u. Magnitude is fairly flat (median 0.12, max 0.22), and the highest values occur with v plus vowel-like tokens early in the sequence.

scorecard.summary: Weighted combination of 40 cues. Raise it: t=2 & prev_tok=e (+5.35), orig0=v (+3.56), prev2_tok=j (+3.55), prev_tok=o (+3.42), orig0=1 (+3.39), orig2=e (+3.31). Lower it: orig_idx=-1 (-3.54), prev3_tok=- (-3.49), phase=2 (-2.04).
